title: Hamada Operations Platform
description: A comprehensive logistics and operations dashboard for Hamada Logistic, featuring real-time tracking, offline-first mobile synchronization, and predictive vehicle maintenance.

problem.title: The Challenge
problem.content:
Hamada Logistic was relying on a legacy system that struggled to handle real-time synchronization between their mobile fleet and the central dispatch. Poor internet connectivity in rural areas caused data loss, and the dispatchers lacked visibility into real-time vehicle status and predictive maintenance needs.

Key technical debt included:
- No offline support for drivers in remote areas
- Manual, paper-based attendance and vehicle checks
- A fragmented architecture that caused frequent downtime

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.content:
We built a unified operations platform from the ground up, utilizing Next.js for the administrative dashboard and React Native for the driver app.

### Key Architectural Decisions:
1. **Offline-First Synchronization**: Implemented WatermelonDB on the mobile client to allow drivers to submit reports and attendance offline, syncing automatically when connectivity is restored.
2. **Real-time Dispatching**: Used WebSockets to instantly update the admin dashboard when a vehicle's status changes.
3. **Modern Tech Stack**: Transitioned to Next.js and Prisma with PostgreSQL for a robust, type-safe backend capable of handling high transactional volume.
4. **QR Code Integration**: Integrated a QR-based system for instant vehicle check-ins and driver attendance.

impact.title: Business Impact
impact.content: The new Hamada Operations Platform dramatically increased operational efficiency. Dispatchers now have 100% real-time visibility into fleet operations, and data loss from offline drivers has been completely eliminated.

results.title: Key Results
results.content:
- **100% elimination** of data loss in rural areas
- **30% reduction** in vehicle downtime through predictive maintenance tracking
- **Automated** attendance and check-in for over 200 drivers daily
- **Sub-second** dashboard load times for admin staff
